critical_code_review_comments: commission_amount is stored in DB (migrated 12000/12870) but the input is bound to commissionAmount(bank) which recomputes from disbursed_amount * commission_percentage. This coincidentally matches the migrated numbers because commission_percentage was set to 1 and 0.99 respectively. If any migrated file has a stored commission_amount that does NOT equal disbursed_amount*commission_percentage/100 (e.g. rounded or manually adjusted in old CRM), the UI will silently display a DIFFERENT number than what is stored. Recommend either (a) render stored value if present else compute, or (b) reconcile the two on migration so they always agree. Not a regression from this migration run, but worth flagging.

Hydration warnings appear in console ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <select>/<option>') - these are caused by the Emergent VE editor overlay injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers, NOT application code. Harmless in preview but noisy.
Non-blocking: Save All button on FileDetailsPage.js line 858 has no data-testid; consider adding save-eligibilities-btn as the description mentions.
